chapter: Banjo career, Armstrong and the Liberty Bell
title: Where Louis Armstrong got his style
summary: Vincent credits Bunk Johnson and what Armstrong learned at the Home, and repeats how Joe Oliver kept him down until a piano player urged him to blow over Oliver.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Ask him where Louis Armstrong got his style.
He said, where did Louis Armstrong get his style here? His style here. They said, burnt. That's what they said. Who said that? He said, got everything. People said, bunk. Funk Johnson.

You know, he learns in the home, though. Well, yeah. I'll just give him, come up his own way, you know. My idea about it. And then, just like I said, when he went under Joe Oliver, the piano playing, say, you better call that Peyton Joe Oliver. He told him, well, let Joe keep him down. Joe used to tell him, blow below him, saw it. Oh. Ask him where he got the name Liberty Bell. Say, why did y'all get the name Liberty Bell? What did he get?
